summary: Five independent fresh-context Opus reviews over this branch (rounds 7-11), each read-only against a live Postgres 16 and each mutation-testing the guards rather than reading them. Round 11 on a1f5a37: no critical, no high; 1 medium, 5 low. It re-derived the 19 media_items cascade children and every keyCols from pg_index, killed its own mutants (sweep block deleted -> 3 failures; sweep moved ahead of the backfills -> 4 assertions; attempt stamp ungated -> 2 failures; a mergeChildren entry dropped -> drift guard), and confirmed both prose corrections from round 10 against the code. Its medium was that the claim-window test seam was a package variable where it only needs to be a Scanner field: as a global it fired for every Scanner, and a t.Parallel() anywhere in the package made the exclusivity test a FALSE FAILURE whose second caller was an unrelated ScanLibrary blocked holding requeueMu. Resolved here by scoping the hook to the Scanner, plus two lows (machine-specific mutation rates stated as flat measurements; a 138-char comment line). Every mutation was re-run against the scoped version: mutex deleted -> caught 10/10 at GOMAXPROCS 1, 2 and 4; hook moved outside the critical section -> 5/5; 0/15 false failures with the lock at each of 1, 2 and 4; the reviewer's own t.Parallel scenario now passes 5/5 under -race. NOTE the reviewed sha was a1f5a37 and this record is against a later tip: the delta is that var-to-field move plus comment rewrapping, re-verified by the reviewer's own mutations but not itself re-reviewed. Two lows are recorded rather than fixed and are in CLAUDE.md: the exclusivity test spends 250ms proving a negative (can only false-PASS, measured 0/60 with the lock), and the sweep loop is not gated by 'interrupted' while the backfill loop is (its own ctx check makes that a one-iteration no-op). Earlier rounds found and closed, each demonstrated live: a partial unique index with keyPredicate left blank let MergeMediaItems delete a duplicate's row while returning nil; dropping the profile predicate from the recap move put one person's private Q&A thread in another profile's conversation with the whole suite green; the never-attempted sweep was unbounded, re-searching and re-embedding a whole library on every fsnotify scan; the sweep queued ahead of the episode backfills, whose signal is raised only in the scan that first sees the file; and a 3.6% flake plus a mutex test that survived its own mutation entirely at GOMAXPROCS=1.
